tours.name: Cancel a Payslip
tours.description: Learn how to cancel a payslip that was created by mistake or computed with wrong data. Payslips cannot be archived, so cancelling is how they are taken out of the payroll.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn how to cancel a payslip that was created by mistake or computed with wrong data. Payslips cannot be archived, so cancelling is how they are taken out of the payroll.

steps.title: Open Payroll
steps.description: Payslips are managed in the Payroll app.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are managed in the Payroll app.

steps.title: Payslips menu
steps.description: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

description_i18n.en_US: The Payslips menu holds the payslips and the batches that group them.

steps.title: All Payslips
steps.description: Every payslip of every employee is listed here, grouped by batch.

description_i18n.en_US: Every payslip of every employee is listed here, grouped by batch.

steps.title: Find the employee
steps.content: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

content_i18n.en_US: Type the employee's name and press Enter.

steps.description: Search first so you open the right payslip. Only cancel a payslip you no longer need.

description_i18n.en_US: Search first so you open the right payslip. Only cancel a payslip you no longer need.

steps.title: Open the group
steps.content: Click the group to show the payslips inside it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the group to show the payslips inside it.

steps.description: Payslips are grouped by batch. Payslips that belong to no batch are in the group called None.

description_i18n.en_US: Payslips are grouped by batch. Payslips that belong to no batch are in the group called None.

steps.title: Open the payslip
steps.content: Click the payslip to open it.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the payslip to open it.

steps.description: The payslip form shows the lines, the worked days and the status.

description_i18n.en_US: The payslip form shows the lines, the worked days and the status.

steps.title: Cancel
steps.description: A payslip cannot be archived or deleted once it has been confirmed. Cancelling puts it in the Cancelled status, where it no longer counts in the payroll. A cancelled payslip can be set back to draft if it was cancelled by mistake.

description_i18n.en_US: A payslip cannot be archived or deleted once it has been confirmed. Cancelling puts it in the Cancelled status, where it no longer counts in the payroll. A cancelled payslip can be set back to draft if it was cancelled by mistake.
